title: ADMaps Pathfinder
description: Dragged tokens walk around walls (A*), stop short when there is no way, and turn toward where they go. Large tokens never stand with a wall inside them; in a fight, players' tokens walk around enemies; Alt goes straight through. Any system. Path search uses the third-party library routinglib by Manuel Vögele (MIT), a patched copy of which ships inside the module — the routinglib module itself is not needed.

recommends.reason: Wraps core's token methods cleanly alongside other modules.
